title: Remove the retired "Host free with Crew" claim from /pricing, llms-full and the home template

source.ref: Launch feature-availability audit item 26 (2026-11-12): Crew is a separate personal membership; hosting a Space is free.

detail: PLAN_STORY already says hosting a Space is free and Crew is separate. Three surfaces still said Host free with Crew: the /pricing meta description, llms-full.txt, the home template hero. They now read Hosting a Space is free. The published home page is a database row set by migration 20270346023000, so the live hero changes only when Daniel runs the SQL given in the PR. The home-copy-canon test fixture still holds the old phrase and needs Daniel's own phrase to edit. The /what-is-frequency template still carries the phrase: changing its words moves a visual-baseline fingerprint (test/e2e/template-fingerprints.test.ts), which needs the e2e-manual update_baselines recapture in the same commit.
